in_sanskrit.name: लेख
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: व्याकरणम् (vyakranam) - grammar, विधि (vidhi) - rule, लेख (lekh) - to write, वर्णनम् (varnana) - description, प्रकाशनम् (prakasanam) - to reveal, संध्याकरणम् (sandhyakarana) - to bring together, ब्रह्मचारिणः (brahmacarins) - celibate students - The name Lekh is derived from the Sanskrit word लेख (lekh), which means 'to write' or 'record'. It can also be understood as 'bringing together', 'revealing', or 'describing'.

in_marathi.name: Lekh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lekh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who writes, records, or documents. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'lekh', meaning 'to write'.
